record.question: Who has become the first Indian to become a member of FIFA Executive Council?
record.explanation: Answer B: Praful Patel. Praful Patel became the first Indian elected to the FIFA Council in 2019. The body was called the FIFA Council, not the Executive Committee, by then. Reference: https://www.the-aiff.com/article/praful-patel-elected-to-fifa-council. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
